title: Targets, discovery, capabilities and requirements remain distinct
summary: DeploymentTarget identifies where work occurs; DeploymentDiscovery is a non-destructive snapshot; DeploymentCapability records what the target can do; DeploymentRequirement records what the desired state needs. The planner compares observations with requirements.
invariants: targetId is opaque and is not assumed equal to hostname, IP address or application worker name.
Capabilities are observations; requirements are declarations.
A requirement must be testable or it must not masquerade as verified state.
Package-manager and platform mechanics belong behind providers, not hard-coded OS heuristics in the model.

provenance.claim: Defines DeploymentTarget identity and separation from host/IP/worker identity.
Separates testable requirements from observed capabilities.
Defines non-destructive discovery and provider ownership of platform mechanics.
